decisions.reason: Premium support builds on the existing support organisation, so it costs little to keep and still offers upside in upselling hosting customers.
The version manager is integrated into the hosting platform alongside other tools such as the security center, so maintenance costs are low and it keeps an option on value-added services open.
The data processing contract tool was a low-cost response to the 2018 GDPR wave; its standalone value is fading but it is cheap to maintain as a compliance service, so it stays for now.
Scalable agency hosting is close to the core business and was featured on the home page, and its uncertainty is still being resolved in a growing segment, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.
